Verified labels A(239,64.9), B(68.3,359.6), C(409.0,360.1), O(239,261.7), F(153.6,212.3) (midpoint of AB, consistent with tangency), E(330.4,223.7) and D(249.3,360.0). BC is horizontal at y~360. Labelled D and E are not at the perpendicular feet from O (feet are at x~239 on BC and the midpoint of AC), so tangency at D and E is only approximate in the labels.
